settings.question: What does the serum do?
settings.answer: It is a cosmetic serum made to support the look of firmer, smoother, more even skin. It is designed to improve the appearance of your skin, not to treat any medical condition.

settings.question: How do I use it?
settings.answer: Apply three to four drops to clean skin morning or evening, then follow with moisturizer. Use sunscreen during the day.

settings.question: Is it safe for me?
settings.answer: The full ingredient list is on the product page so you can check it against anything you avoid. The serum contains royal jelly, so if you are allergic to bee products, do not use it.

settings.question: When will my order arrive?
settings.answer: First Edition orders ship within one to three business days as each batch is prepared. You will get a confirmation and tracking the moment yours is on the way.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: Unopened bottles can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a refund. For hygiene and safety, once a bottle has been opened or used it cannot be returned. If your order arrives damaged, send us a photo within 48 hours and we will replace it.

settings.question: Can I cancel my subscription?
settings.answer: Yes, any time. Change your delivery schedule or cancel from your account whenever you like.
